brief: Walks through the characters of a text by position: forwards or backwards, with a step, with code run on each, or along named walkers.
detail: Build one with new stzStringWalker("abcdefghij"); it only reads, so a stzString passed in is never changed. CharsFromTo and CharsWithStep answer lists of characters; WalkAndYield runs a piece of code on each visited character. AddWalker keeps a named walker of numbers, whose steps are given as a list, and Walker gives back the numbers it visits. A step of 0 in CharsWithStep or WalkAndYield never ends, so never give one. Positions count from 1 in characters.
